text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, fewer late-night CRM updates.

**2. Notes became shared memory.** When an account changed hands, the new rep could read the real conversation history instead of guessing.

**3. Customers noticed.** Asking permission upfront built trust. Two prospects even asked for the summary.

**4. Adoption wasn't automatic.** Reps who got a short template for reviewing summaries stuck with it. Those who didn't, drifted.

**5. Accuracy needs a human.** Product names and pricing details still needed a quick check.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It protected the time we needed to use it.

What has your team learned from AI pilots?
